releaseTitle: ATalk v3.10.0 — Unified Real-Time Structural Component Synchronization Suite
releaseNotes:
• 01 Unified Calling & Voice Audio Hub: Live sync between MiniCapsule HUD, ActiveCallScreen, and voice notes via CallStateManager & GlobalAudioPlaybackCoordinator enforcing strict single-track playback.
• 02 Conversation State Hub: Centralized reactive bus for pinned order (1st..10th preserved), muted conversations, and disappearing message timers across all sheets, overflow menus, and room views.
• 03 Starred Message State Sync: Real-time reactive StateFlow across chat bubbles, context actions, and starred message browser.
• 04 Encrypted Safe Media Catalog: Live reactive flow updates the safe catalog instantly when items are added, deleted, or decrypted.
• 05 Contact Nicknames & Identity Bus: Real-time propagation of custom contact names and edits across room headers, conversation list items, and contacts directory.
• 06 Chat Backups & Restore Invalidation Bus: Frame-0 zero-flicker cache invalidation listener hot-swapping restored or cleared conversations.
• 07 Live Theme & Wallpaper Canvas Reactivity: Real-time state flows propagate pattern selection and doodle opacity live behind the modal sheet.
• 08 Multi-Select Contextual BackHandler: Hardware and gesture back interception cleanly dismisses multi-selection state without accidental screen exits.
